clips.caption:
Forty of Kevin Trudeau's friends sat in a room with a combined net worth of over $1 trillion. One of them personally controls a $750 billion hedge fund.

Kevin asked them all the same question: how many of you have read Think and Grow Rich, or studied the law of attraction? Almost none of them had.

The one book nearly every one of them had actually read was How to Win Friends and Influence People. Most had taken the full Dale Carnegie course - some companies required it for executives.

Not manifesting. Not visualization. People skills.

Everything works through people. Unless you can connect with someone, nothing else you've learned matters.
